name: CG Power & Industrial Solutions Ltd

ledger.quote: So by September, we will be up and running to that, from current approximately 20,000 MVA.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: 1,10,000 MVAs capacity by end of calendar year is pending.

ledger.quote: And overall, at company level, if you tell me, I think at some stage, we will bounce back to 14%, 15% PBT margins.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: PBT margins target remains unspecified and unfulfilled.

ledger.quote: Now CG Semi is absolutely on track. The mini plant as we had projected, '26, it will start production.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: CG Semi commercial production at G1 OSAT facility launched in July 2026.
ledger.evidence: CG Semi, which is a subsidiary of CG Power Industrial Solutions announced the commencement of commercial production at its G1 OSAT facility in Sanand.

ledger.quote: And the main plant, which is the larger one, will start production in '27.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: Main plant production target is set for 2027.

ledger.quote: So I think we will keep on investing. One is the portfolio that we have across different businesses.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: Investment continues across different businesses.
ledger.evidence: So we'll continue to invest into this area. It won't slow down.

ledger.quote: So hopefully, in next few months, we will get the approval and that will start the supplies piece of it.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: EV motor supplies approval timeline is still pending.

ledger.quote: I think, Bhalchandra, for Power, honestly, I am very, very bullish for even next 5 years.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: Bullish outlook for the next 5 years remains ongoing.

ledger.quote: And then that's the reason also why we have to keep filling up the pie and bring it there.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: Order backlog filled, reaching INR 18,965 crores at consolidated level.
ledger.evidence: And unexecuted order backlog as of 30th June '26 was 45% year-over-year at INR18,965 crores.

ledger.quote: G2, which is the main plant, which is the large plant, just 3 kilometers away from the current facility under construction, expected to be closed by end of next year or early '27.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.by_when: end of next year or early '27
ledger.verdict: G2 facility completion expected by end of calendar year 2026.

ledger.quote: For Axiro, which is our subsidiary, I think they should do approximately $50 million.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: Axiro revenue target for current year remains pending.

ledger.quote: Hopefully, by end of December, we should be in a position to get all this cleared out and start the shipments.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: KAVACH shipments waiting for RDSO and ISA approvals.

ledger.quote: So, as per the plan, that is '27-'28, but the way we are executing, I think we will be much ahead of the target.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.target: bring online next phase ahead of '27-'28
ledger.verdict: Bringing online next phase ahead of 2027-2028 is still in progress.

ledger.quote: So, this is important for the business sustainability point of view also. And from the current capacities also, as of now, the exports are around 10%, so it will grow to around 20% in these
ledger.speaker: Ajay Jain
ledger.verdict: Export growth to 20% remains an ongoing target.

ledger.quote: I think we should be probably coming out with a complete Make in India solution for our 400 kV GIS in the next fiscal year.
ledger.speaker: Gaurav Makhija
ledger.verdict: 400 kV GIS commercialization target is financial year 2027.

ledger.quote: That will come up, and I think that itself should give us close to INR 400 crores incremental revenue or sales.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: Incremental revenue target is pending realization.

ledger.quote: And in the next 1 quarter or so, we'll be 65,000 MVA.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: Could not verify the evidence for this one in the latest call.

ledger.quote: The order expected to be completed between 18 to 36 months.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.target: complete PowerGrid order in 18 to 36 months
ledger.verdict: PowerGrid order completion timeline is 18 to 36 months.

ledger.quote: Once operational, G2 will scale up to the capacity of approximately 14.5 million chips per day.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.target: 14.5 million chips per day capacity at G2
ledger.verdict: G2 scale up capacity target remains pending.

ledger.quote: This order will be executed for a delivery period of 12 to 20 months with the delivery terms of FAS Mumbai port (Incoterms 2020)..
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: US data centre order delivery period is 12 to 20 months.

ledger.quote: And initially we will be starting with the capacity of around 25,000 to 30,000 MVA and by the end of this calendar year we will be touching the peak of 45,000 MVA there.
ledger.speaker: Ajay Jain
ledger.verdict: Greenfield plant commissioning timeline is pending completion.

ledger.quote: Business continues to prioritize margin expansion through ongoing cost initiatives, structural improvements, pricing, and mix shaping.
ledger.speaker: Amar Kaul
ledger.verdict: Margin expansion achieved with Power Systems PBIT margin at 23% and consol OPM at 14% in Sep 2026.
ledger.evidence: Sep 2026 OPM 14.0%, Power Systems PBIT margin 23%

open.quote: In fact, the first range across IE3, IE4 and IE5, all this full range will be complete in the next 12 months.
open.speaker: Amar Kaul
open.target: complete full range of IE3, IE4 and IE5 motors

read: Management delivers on capacity expansions and commercializes new ventures like CG Semi on schedule. Financial execution remains consistent with strong order backlog growth and stable margins.
questions: When exactly will KAVACH receive RDSO approval for commercial shipments?
What is the current execution status and timeline for the Axiro subsidiary revenue target?
bull: Consolidated order backlog reached INR 18,965 crores, up 45% year-over-year.
Power Systems PBIT margin expanded to 23% with strong execution discipline.
bear: Railway segment incurred a one-off provision of INR 20 crores.
Semiconductor segment investments caused a consolidated impact of INR 43 crores.
